prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
text:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, red ball. Lily loved to play with her ball. One day, she saw a big, red ball in the park. Lily wanted to play with the ball, but she was too shy to ask.
Lily had an idea. She would ask her friend, Tom, to help her. Tom said, "Lily, can you help me? I want to play with the ball too." Lily was happy to help. They played together and had lots of fun.
After playing, Lily and Tom were tired. They sat under a big tree to rest. They talked and laughed. Lily said, "I like your ball, Tom. It's fun to play with." Tom smiled and said, "Me too, Lily. I like your ball." They played together all day, and Lily was not shy anymore.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
text:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big heart. One day, she went to the park to play.
At the park, Lily saw a big tree. The tree had many branches. Lily wanted to climb the tree. She climbed up the tree and saw many birds. She climbed up and sat on a branch.
A small bird flew down from the tree. The bird was nice and let Lily touch its branches. The bird saw the tree and wanted to touch it. Lily used the wings to stand up and hold on.
But then, something unexpected happened. The tree began to shake. The bird saw the aeroplane and was scared. It landed on the tree. Lily was scared, but she knew the bird was safe. The bird flew back down from the tree and started to fly.
Lily was so happy and proud of herself. She knew that she had found something to do. And that was the tree that was not scary at all.
